full_text: Hello. Hello. Hello, kaise ho? Aapke area mein kya ho raha hai? Haan ji, kaise ho? Hello, kaise ho? Kahan se ho? Main Kerala. Kya bol rahe ho, sir, aap? Kya? Band ho gaya. Kitna? Phone lag raha hai, Instagram. Hello? Aur sunaiye.
